notes: Steam leak at flange gasket on P-103, old gasket hard and cracked with age. Isolated, replaced 1 x flange gasket FG-100, retorqued bolts. Labor 1.5 h.
CV-203 tail pulley bearing worn, excessive play. Replaced 2 x bearing 6205-2RS and 1 x lip seal LS-35. Labor 3.5 h.
Impeller on F-403 eroded, flow down. Fitted new impeller 44-0918 and 1 x wear ring WR-150. Labor 4 h.
P-104 casing gasket leaking water onto motor. Replaced gasket.
Operator reported a leak at the P-105 seal. Ran the pump and checked, seal dry, no leak found. Puddle was from the wash-down hose. Labor 0.5 h.

Called out at 02:10 by control room because GB-501 was making a loud knocking noise and the vibration monitor showed a step change on the output shaft. On arrival the gearbox was still running with the line at reduced rate. Operator reported the noise started after the morning product changeover and got worse over the shift. We checked the oil level, which was normal, and took an oil sample which looked clean with no visible metal. Checked the coupling guard and base bolts, all tight. Used the handheld meter on the input and output bearings: readings on the output bearing were well above alarm, the input side was normal. With permission from the shift lead we stopped the line, isolated and locked out the drive, removed the coupling guard and found the coupling misaligned by roughly half a millimetre after the motor had been moved during last week's motor swap. Shims under the motor feet had been left out on the non drive end. We refitted the shims, realigned the coupling with the laser kit to within tolerance, refitted the guard and restarted. Vibration on the output bearing dropped back to its normal level and the knocking stopped. Line down from 03:10 to 05:40. Labor 2 x 3.5 h. Recommend adding an alignment check to the motor change procedure and a follow-up vibration reading next week to confirm the bearing has not been damaged by the running time.
Quarterly lubrication of F-402 per PM schedule. Greased both bearings. Found coupling guard cracked at the mounting bracket, needs replacing: raise a follow-up order for a new guard. Labor 1 h.
P-106 tripped on overload, breaker would not reset. Found burnt contactor, replaced 1 x contactor CT-40. Pump down 45 min.
M-701 drive belts worn and glazed, slipping. Replaced drive belts and retensioned. Labor 1.5 h.
